_approach: RYM lists Jerk (LA jerk/hyphy-adjacent) among krushclub's cross-pollinations. This groove adds a soft 'gallop' kick on the 16th right before beats 2 and 4 (borrowed vocabulary from hard-dance double-kicks, applied to the Jersey shape) so the low end skips like a jerk beat, while the snare/clap keeps a straight 2-and-4 backbone. Rim ghosts fill the jerk-style shuffle in the gaps. Distinct from the pure 5-kick Jersey groove because the extra kicks land on 16ths, not the Jersey a-of-3/&-of-4 slots.
